newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudanese official says Eritrean landmines kill two.
newsitem.headline: Sudanese official says Eritrean landmines kill two.

text.p: A Sudanese official said in comments published on Thursday that two students were killed and 70 wounded when landmines planted by Eritrean forces exploded in northeastern Sudan.

Salaheddin Abdalla, commissioner of the northeastern province of Hamash Koreb, said in remarks carried by the privately owned Alwan newspaper that two students at a Koranic school were killed by landmines planted by Eritreans near the school.
Seventy students were wounded in the blasts, Abdalla said. He did not give a date for the explosions.
Sudan accuses neighouring Eritrea of launching cross-border attacks and of helping rebels opposed to the Khartoum government. Eritrea denies the charges.
